/**
 * ====================================================================
 * MEMORIES PHOTO COLLECTION (20 Shuffled Frames)

 * Add or replace your photos inside the public/images/ directory:
 *   public/images/photo1.jpg ... photo20.jpg
 *
 * Each memory configures aspect ratio, rotation, and objectPosition
 * so that faces and people are always framed properly without any cutoffs.
 */

export const memories = [
  {
    id: 1,
    image: "/images/photo1.jpg",
    caption: "The look on your face right before another burst of laughter.",
    tag: "Pure Joy",
    date: "A quiet moment",
    rotation: -2.2,
    yOffset: -8,
    scale: 1.02,
    aspect: "4/5",
    width: "280px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
  {
    id: 2,

  },
  {
    id: 16,

    aspect: "3/4",
    width: "285px",
    objectPosition: "center 20%",
  },
];
